caseNameFull: John COPELAND v. Cyrus R. VANCE, Jr.

opinions.text: Motion of The Legal Aid Society for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Motion of Criminal Law Professors, et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Motion of Constitutional Law Scholars for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit denied.
